sources.locator: Official ASNEF.FIN.DAT; complete transient scan of 9,200,232 fixed-width records; three accepted private-identifier matches; identifiers withheld
sources.collection_name: World War II Army Enlistment Records
sources.rights_notes: No raw row or full private identifier is retained. John J Davidson and Kenneth E Davidson have exact identifier-and-name matches. John T Davidson Jr. has an exact identifier match and token-equivalent full name; suffix storage order explains the mechanical raw-name mismatch. Name-only rows for Milton Davidson, Thomas Davidson, and Alfred Davies remain unassigned. The incomplete Army file is not a comprehensive OSS, officer, Navy, Marine Corps, civilian, WAC, Coast Guard, or foreign roster; a non-hit is not negative proof.

sources.rights_notes: NARA's documentation warns that historical occupation-code interpretations can be imperfect. The codes identify neither a specific employer nor the sequence from Army service to OSS. Broad and residual occupational wording is preserved without modernization.

affiliations.role_title: Manager or official, not elsewhere classified
affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation value 097 was recorded at Army entry on May 26, 1943. NARA's code table defines 0-97 as managers and officials, n.e.c.; no employer, industry, office, or work location is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and full name confirm the Army identity. The residual category is not converted into a named employer, industry, or executive title.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation value 137 was recorded at Army entry on August 22, 1942. NARA's code table defines 1-37 as stenographers and typists; no employer, office, or work location is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and token-equivalent full name confirm the Army identity. The occupation is not converted into a named employer or office.

affiliations.date_precision: Civilian-occupation value 316 was recorded at Army entry on March 11, 1943. NARA's code table defines 3-16 as farm hands, general farms; no farm, owner, crop, or work location is identified.
affiliations.research_notes: The exact private identifier and full name confirm the Army identity. The occupation is not converted into a named employer, farm, or self-employment claim.
